latestVersion.changelog:
percept-summarize 1.0.0

- Initial release of percept-summarize skill for automated conversation summarization.
- Generates AI-powered summaries with entity extraction (people, companies, topics), relationship mapping, and action items.
- Summaries and entities stored locally in SQLite with full-text search.
- Entity resolution uses a 5-stage cascade, including fuzzy and semantic matching.
- Requires percept-listen skill and OpenClaw agent for AI processing.
- Searchable summaries via dashboard (port 8960) or directly in SQLite.
